senses.gloss:
फु(फू)त्
ind. An onomatopoetic word generally used in composition with कृ, and imitative of the sound made by blowing into liquids &c.; sometimes it expresses disregard or contempt; फु (फू) त्कृ 
__1 To blow into (a liquid); बालः पायसदग्धो दध्यपि फूत्कृत्य भक्षयति [[H. 4. 103.]] 
__2 To scream aloud, cry, shriek. 
-Comp. 
-कारः, -कृतम्, -कृतिः f. 
__1 blowing into. 
__2 hissing, whizzing. 
__3 the hiss of a serpent. 
__4 sobbing. 
__5 screaming, a loud shriek, yell. फूत्काररन्ध्रम् the hole of a flute. 
-कृत a. 
__1 blown into &c. 
__2 blown up (as a bubble.) 
__3 screamed aloud. 
(-तम्) 
__1 the sound of a wind-instrument. 
__2 a loud cry, shriek, scream. 
-कृतिः 
__1 the blowing of a wind instrument. 
__2 blowing, hissing. 
__3 crying aloud.
